effects.name: Noise Dissolve
effects.path: Image/procedural/native-render-layer Texture2D or AirRenderTarget color → native quad Material; local seeded noise + progress threshold + declared alpha/soft edge.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 effect draw; rendered-layer source may add 1 capture
oracles: progress=0 preserves input (including RGBA), progress=1 obeys declared complete removal; explicit branches avoid edge-only residue.

Same floating seed/domain offsets (not integerPRNG), frozen input/progress repeats exact field; no time in upstream E01. Independent three-octave Perlin/hash/reveal checkgrid+coverage endpoints; difference from upstreamnoise explicitly declared.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: progress 0 visible / 1 erased at all softness; seed is floating domain displacement, not integer PRNG; field has no time.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Freeze domain/hash algorithm, alpha representation and UV origin. Explicit noise implementation must identify differences from MaterialX-derived upstream helper; generic sin-hash is not byte-equivalent.

effects.name: Thin Film
effects.path: Native quad fragment signed distance + derivative antialias + edge gradient/phase rainbow palette; source SDF/raster boundary declared.
oracles: Analytic circle/box sample distances with inside/outside sign and boundary continuous transition across DPR.
Freeze palette phase/period with independent expected stops; optical-looking color is not proof of physical thin-film interference.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: Scale-adjusted SDF; rimWidth has 0.1 scale; degrees lightAngle; rainbow phases 0,0.3333,0.6667; custom mode/colorSpace are structural branches.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Visual iridescence model, not spectral optical thin-film interference. Analytic 2D SDF first is permitted with explicitly narrower shape coverage; derivative fwidth is local AA, not a substitute for normal gradient.

effects.name: Holographic
effects.path: Native texture/quad shader uses seeded noise finite-gradient normal, viewing/light direction and phase/time color; explicit transfer.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 material draw; any upstream neighborhood stage to be justified after source analysis
oracles: Fixed seed/time reconstructs normals/color; central-difference CPU gradients and direction sweep agree.
Time t / t+dt / pause/resume continuity; exact transfer patch tests, no claim physical rainbow unless derived.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: Normal stencil 0.008; wrinkle stencil 0.02; hueShift degrees /360; exact thirds palette; accumulated animated time; upstream exposes no seed.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Adding local seed is an extension; fixed time alone reproduces the original fixed-domain noise. Macro surface-locked and screen-stable grain domains must not be conflated. Not a holographic wave simulation.

effects.name: Neon
effects.path: Native quad SDF analytic tube/core/glow falloff; standard native blend states over known backdrop.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 draw for analytic glow; optional blur adds explicit capture+2 blur draws only if needed
oracles: Independent core/tube/glow toggles and radial profiles; core radius/falloff expected samples and symmetry.
Straight/premultiplied RGBA composition at transparent boundary, black/white/colored backdrops; off identity.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: Center plus cardinal SDF neighbors; core/tube/glow controls separate; glow cutoff forces distant alpha=0; flicker/flow use time.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Implement analytic glow before any extra Bloom pass; report straight/associated color and blend state; reverse-edge smoothstep in source must become ordered-edge explicit inverse in GLSL.

effects.name: Emboss
effects.path: Native texture sampling height gradient + normal/light dot + parallax-like local UV offset; input-alpha preservation.
oracles: Ramp height: known gradient normal, opposite light direction swaps shading; flat height has zero emboss.
Symmetric finite differences + sample texel size; transparent input carries declared alpha with no fringe; offset=0 identity.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: Child RTT is premultiplied; unpremultiply before color math then return straight RGBA; signed depth controls raised/sunken; outside shape passes input through.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: No physical displacement geometry claim. Test a known planar/ramp height with reversed light and signed depth, transparent input hidden RGB and no double premultiply.

effects.name: Sparkle
effects.path: Native quad samples texture luminance/neighborhood; bounded star rays with time/seed; radius units explicitly pixel or CSS.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 bounded sampling draw; any prefilter target separately counted
oracles: Upstream gates alpha-weighted brightest-neighbor luminance using sqrt(linear Rec709 luma), threshold band0.12 (not raw encodedRGB or simplistic hard >= threshold). Independent samples include alpha0 bright color, intensity0 identity, exact band/tie policy, isolated point/ray geometry.
Equivalent radius in declared units across720p/1080p/DPR; t/seed repeated; threshold maximum extinguishes pattern.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: CSS-pixel size/rays/expand; threshold on sqrt(linear luma), band=0.12; Rec709 luma weights; intensity=0 identity; expand crossing zero changes tap topology; seed domain differs per layer.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Do not threshold already gamma-encoded RGB; alpha-zero bright input must not spawn stars. Match DPR in logical coordinates and constrain neighborhoods/edge mode; no global bloom proxy.

effects.name: Liquid Metal
effects.path: Native quad/material local noise gradients and reflection palette; deterministic animation; local quality variants or bounded loop.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 material draw; quality sampling/octaves explicitly reported
oracles: Independent CPU gradients/normal sanity finite/unit; fixed seed/time repeat and quality delta measurable.
Visual reflective material only, not Navier–Stokes simulation; each quality mode compile boundary/cache identity verified.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: Ripple frequency times2.6; flow time times0.12; desktop chromatic split vs mobile shared evaluation is build-time device branch; upstream exposes no seed.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Visual material, not a fluid simulation. Local explicit quality tiers replace upstream hidden viewport heuristic only as documented divergence; freeze view/reflection/color domains and measure tier cost.

effects.name: Cursor Trail
effects.path: One real pointer/touch path → bounded CPU ring buffer/curve vertices → native Texture2D data upload or dynamic Mesh → native shader curve-distance alpha.
effects.plannedPasses: 1 curve draw; bounded data texture max capacity fixed
oracles: Recorded down/move/up/cancel/pointerId → local CSS/backing transform → uploaded positions → independently reconstruct curve distance/coverage.
Max history enforced, generation invalidates late up; touch+resize+pause+100destroy leaves no listeners/RAF/owneddata; identical logged stream repeated.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: MAX_POINTS64 including duplicate head; three Bezier subdivisions; speed dt cap0.1s / age cap0.25s; aspect-correct distance; width signed to encode connectivity; newest-overlap paint logic.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Use Cocos input and director lifecycle; never copy RAF/runtime listeners. Define touch IDs, outside/cancel/resize policy; float32 vs upstream half16 and host smoothing differences affect numerical equivalence.

effects.name: Glass
effects.path: Native source camera/layer → AirRenderTarget scene texture → native glass shader UV refraction, blur, RGB dispersion/highlight; capture excludes self.
effects.plannedPasses: capture +1 glass consumer; separable blur optionally+2 draws and explicit intermediate RTs
oracles: Checker/color grid: refraction vector/sign, edge-clamp, per-channel dispersion sample positions independently computed; zero parameters identity.
Real scene updates observed, target generations rebind on resize; no read-write feedback; actual camera/pass/draw count and RT binding audited.
Blur impulse kernel energy/symmetry, highlightradius controls, overlapalpha backdrops, offscreen/compositor agree.

upstreamReference.semantic_contract: requiresRTT and child=true; blur and aberration crossing zero trigger structural recompilation; blur radius=blur*2; RTT samples premultiplied, effect math straight; first-lobe thickness for volumetric mode.
upstreamReference.implementation_differences: Implement Cocos RenderTexture ownership and Camera passes, not upstream compute runtime. Declare local blur kernel/edge/sample mapping and physical-lens limitations; count actual offscreen/blur/final passes.

cpuUpdate.method: Named Director.EVENT_BEFORE_UPDATE/AFTER_UPDATE performance.now interval + separate effectInstance.update(t,dt) bracketing. Record callback overhead and sample arrays; excludes claiming GPU time.

cpuEncodingSubmission.method: Director.EVENT_BEFORE_DRAW/AFTER_DRAW elapsed CPU interval; label as render traversal/encoding/submission envelope, not pure driver submit. Separately bracket user setProperty/uploadData operations, never gl.finish per frame.

frameTime.method: Consecutive native AFTER_DRAW or RAF presentation callback intervals, exact label recorded. Use native pacer for perf, no step clock or screenshots during steady window. Warmup/duration/repeats/candidate/workload/version/device frozen before acceptance.

gpuTimestamp.extension: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 must be queried on actual device
gpuTimestamp.publicEnginePath: No query create/begin/end/results method in current gfx.Device/CommandBuffer declarations; QueryType.TIMESTAMP enum existence is not a usable timer.
gpuTimestamp.policy: GPUelapsed via existing-context EXT diagnostic is authorized measurement instrumentation, not a rendering bypass; label TOOL_DIAGNOSTIC and do not claim gfx public API support. Chromium supported extension should be measured in Wave1; Firefox/WebKit current extension unsupported recorded unavailable. No queries executed in Wave0. CPU update/encoding/submission/frame are distinct and never relabeled gpuTime.

independentDiagnostic.label: TOOL_DIAGNOSTIC_GPU_ELAPSED_EXTENSION
independentDiagnostic.feasibility: Chromium supports EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 in Lead observation. Optional tool can wrap existing native Director BEFORE_DRAW/AFTER_DRAW submission with TIME_ELAPSED_EXT queries on the existing device context (no canvas/no draws/no effect runtime bypass), asynchronously poll query availability after frames; reject GPU_DISJOINT_EXT/nonfinite or overlapping active query; ns→ms. Own/delete only its queries at release and quantify instrumentation overhead. FF/WK do not report extension here; record unavailable rather than force failure.
independentDiagnostic.limitation: This instrumentation is separate from native API measurement/support; it does not prove gfx exposes GPUtimer, is not itself an effect implementation, and has not been executed in Wave0.

draws.method: After native present use director.root.device.numDrawCalls/numTris/numInstances; reset per-frame by WebGL2Device.present queue.clear. Record before/after baseline, all cameras; material.passes.length only describes material passes, not total pipeline draws.

passCount.method: Maintain explicit registered camera/order/target/consumer pass receipts, enumerate material passes, capture begin/end events. Distinguish effect draws/renderpasses/MSAAresolve/copy and fullengine total. No universal framepass counter public API found.

allocations.method: Owner ledger for Texture2D/RenderTexture/Material/Mesh/effect/GFXbuffer instances and refCount; gfx.memoryStatus.textureSize and bufferSize are engine accounting bytes, not liveobject count or physicalGPUmemory.

vramEstimate.method: Sum declared actual allocation dimensions × format bytes/texel × layers × mip levels; MSAA color/depth+separate resolved texture included; buffers actual byteLength. Label estimate, describe driver alignment/tiling/hidden cache excluded; physical VRAM unavailable.

statistics.method: Persist every raw sample, p50/p95/p99 via frozen quantile convention + worst, samplesDropped ifany with reason. No guessed60fps/PASS budget; no workload/case rejection on screenshot resemblance.

viewports.limitation: Browser emulation only; realphoneGPU/perf/physicaltouch NOT_RUN; cap2 recorded. TestDPR3 separately only with explicitcap3 beforeimport and actualallocation check.

measurements.viewportPolicy: Expected backing is a plan, not a fact. Freeze/read canvas and viewport actual size/rt effective dims eachcase, including live resize; maxTextureSize/format capability conditional. Lead preflight may establish existingSDK local startup; not9 effectsEG or deviceperformance.

cpuEncoding.method: Tool may instrument native CommandBuffer.begin/end/record and Queue.submit calls, preserving original invocation/context and restoring exact wrapper identities. Record distinct raw timing arrays for encoding vs submission when actual backend exposes both. Legacy WebGL2 primary command recording may directly execute GL operations, so report inseparable envelope honestly when this occurs; do not duplicate one array under two labels.
cpuEncoding.limitation: Tool instrumentation does not replace engine command creation/submission and is not a new public SDK profiler API.

cpuSubmission.method: Separately bracket actual native Queue.submit if present in the effect path; keep command buffer encoding interval separate with exact frame/phase IDs. If submit is merely an empty/control stage while GL executes earlier, disclose backend behavior and preserve time values, not claim GPUwork.
cpuSubmission.limitation: If pilot cannot separate actual encode/submit, use a single render CPU envelope and explicitly mark both unsplit quantities unavailable.
